summary.text: Silas Miller is a Democratic member of the Kansas Senate representing District 25 (Sedgwick County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2025.
Silas Miller is listed as the ranking minority member of the Financial Institutions and Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Silas Miller served in the House (2023–2025) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2025.
Silas Miller is listed as a member of the Financial Institutions and Insurance Committee, the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and the Commerce Committee.
The Legislature lists Silas Miller's occupation as Insurance Broker Family First Life.
The page names Bailey Miller as Silas Miller's spouse.
